questions.problem:
Consider the set $Y={1,6,11,16,21,26,31,36}.$ Which subset must be placed into the blank in the set below so that it represents a partition of $Y?$

$$
{{1,16,36},{11,31},\,____\,}
$$
questions.worked_solution:
A partition of a set $Y$ is a collection of non-empty subsets of $Y$ where every element of $Y$ is contained in *exactly* one subset. 

To find the subset that goes in the blank, we must identify which elements of $Y$ are not yet contained within any of the given subsets.

Let's go through each element of $Y$ and check:

- $1\in {1,16,36}\,✓$

- $6$ does not belong to any of the given subsets $\,\times $

- $11\in {11,31}\,✓$

- $16\in {1,16,36}\,✓$

- $21$ does not belong to any of the given subsets $\,\times $

- $26$ does not belong to any of the given subsets $\,\times $

- $31\in {11,31}\,✓$

- $36\in {1,16,36}\,✓$

The elements $6,$ $21,$ and $26$ are not yet contained within any of the given subsets. Therefore, the subset that must go in the blank is ${6,21,26}.$
